preview.title: Analysis preview
preview.cvUnavailable: Continuous tracking and event detection are not available. Unknown stays unknown.
preview.noMetadata: This phone did not report resolution or frame rate for this file.

warning.low_resolution: Lower than 720p: shirt numbers far from the camera may be unreadable, so identity may stay unconfirmed.
warning.low_frame_rate: Under 24 frames per second: quick actions may fall between frames.
warning.low_bitrate: Strong compression for this resolution: fine details such as numbers may be smeared.
warning.portrait: The video looks portrait (as stored): less of the pitch is usually visible.
warning.track_unsupported: This phone reports the video format as unsupported; the server check decides whether it can be read.
warning.metadata_unavailable: Resolution could not be read on the phone, so quality hints are incomplete.
warning.large_file: Large file: the upload may take a long time on mobile data.

blocker.too_short: This video has no playable length.
blocker.too_long: This video is longer than the 150-minute limit.
blocker.too_large: This file is larger than the 4 GB upload limit.

preview.notChecked: Not checked on the phone: sharpness, lighting, camera angle and whether you are visible.
preview.advisory: These are hints only. PitchProof never refuses a video because of a quality score.

identity.title: Confirm this is you
identity.hint: Select sampled frames that show your jersey. Stats stay unknown until identity is confirmed.
identity.confirmed: Identity confirmed for the selected frames.
identity.rejected: Identity was not confirmed. Countable stats stay unknown.

ask.title: Ask this match
ask.hint: Questions are answered only from stored observations and events. Nothing is invented.
ask.question: Your question
ask.placeholder: e.g. Did you see a shot?

report.title: Match analysis
report.missing: This analysis could not be loaded.
report.statsUnknown: Countable stats stay unknown until validated events exist.
report.cvUnavailable: This view needs computer-vision tracking, which is not deployed.
report.noVideo: The original video is not available. It was deleted after analysis unless you chose to keep it. Timestamps still refer to that footage; open cited frames from the report for evidence.
report.reelHint: Turn the moments from this report into a private reel draft you can review and edit.

modal.title: Analyze match video
modal.intro: PitchProof samples still frames across your film, asks you to confirm identity, and reports only what those frames support. Tracking and match stats stay unknown without a computer-vision worker.

technique.title: Technique stars
technique.basis: Estimated from sampled still frames on a 1–5 star scale. This is an AI read of a few moments, not a verified rating.
technique.unavailable: This report has no technique assessment. Run a new analysis to get star ratings for weak foot, skill moves and more.
technique.identityRequired: Technique stars need you to confirm which frames show you before the analysis runs. Confirm your identity, then analyse again.
technique.noneRated: The sampled frames did not show enough of you on the ball to give a star rating. Footage closer to the action helps.

quality.title: Analysis quality
quality.canTellTitle: What this analysis can tell you
quality.canTellEmpty: Nothing could be confirmed from this video.

canTell.identity_confirmed: You confirmed the tracked player is you
canTell.visible_share: You were visible for about {{pct}}% of the footage

uncertain.off_camera: About {{pct}}% of the match was likely off camera
uncertain.identity_unconfirmed: The tracked player has not been confirmed as you
uncertain.cv_unavailable: Statistics that need computer vision (not available): {{count}}

sync.title: Sync with GPS
sync.noSessions: No completed GPS session to sync with.
sync.instructions: Choose the GPS session from this match, play the video to the moment you started recording, then mark it.
sync.markNow: Mark current video time as GPS start
sync.pointsUnavailable: Sprint detail is only available for sessions recorded with the current version of PitchProof.
sync.noSprints: No sprints were detected in this session.

modalReport.noCoverage: No reliable player coverage estimate was recorded.
modalReport.apply: Apply stats to my match log
modalReport.applyBlocked: Countable stats stay unknown until your identity is confirmed and validated events exist. Log the match yourself instead.
modalReport.buildReel: Build a highlight reel from this analysis

modalForm.pickFailed: The video couldn't be opened. Please try another file.
modalForm.jerseyRequired: Enter your jersey number so the analysis can find you.
modalForm.noEvidenceBody: Countable stats weren't estimated from this footage.
modalForm.savedBody: The estimated stats were added to your match log.
modalForm.saveFailed: Your match log couldn't be saved. Please try again.
modalForm.retryNote: Your footage is already uploaded, so retrying won't upload it again.
modalForm.notesPlaceholder: e.g. I played right midfield after minute 60

errors.frames_insufficient: Not enough clear frames of the match could be read. Try a steadier or brighter recording.
errors.model_unavailable: The analysis service is unavailable right now. Your video is saved — try again later.
errors.model_output_invalid: The analysis could not be completed. Your video is saved — try again.
errors.ai_consent_required: AI analysis is turned off. Turn it on in the Privacy Center to analyze footage.
errors.extraction_failed: Key frames could not be extracted from this video.
errors.queue_unavailable: Analysis could not be queued. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.video_rejected: This video did not pass the format and length checks.
errors.ai_privacy_configuration_required: Video analysis isn't available yet. You can still log matches and track your development.
errors.video_consent_required: Consent for this video is missing or was withdrawn. Start the analysis again to give consent.

pipeline.title: Analysis in progress
pipeline.stageBased: Progress is shown by stage. You can close this screen; the analysis continues on our servers.
pipeline.queued: Waiting in the queue. One full match is analyzed per player at a time.
pipeline.deviceFallback: Analyze using frames from this phone

mode.SHORT_CLIP: Short clip (up to 60 s). Still frames are taken on this phone; the video itself is not uploaded.
mode.MATCH_CLIP: Match clip (up to 20 min). The video is uploaded and reviewed segment by segment.
mode.FULL_MATCH: Full match. The video is uploaded and reviewed segment by segment.
mode.TRAINING_CLIP: Training clip. Reviewed as training, not as match performance.
mode.tooLong: Videos can be up to {{minutes}} minutes long.

consent.title: Before we analyse your video
consent.deviceSummary: Only {{count}} still frames from this clip are uploaded. The video stays on your phone.
consent.cloudSummary: Your video is uploaded to PitchProof cloud storage so still frames can be taken from it.

ack.processing: I want PitchProof to analyse this video. The analysis can be wrong and only reports what the frames show.
ack.rights: I am allowed to use this footage. Only I am followed in it; nobody is identified by their face.
ack.retention: Unless I choose otherwise below, the original video is deleted after the analysis. Only the frames the report cites are kept, privately, until I delete the analysis.
ack.provider: Still frames are sent to an AI model provider set up for zero data retention.

consent.keepVideoHint: Saves the original video privately in your media library so you can rewatch moments. Off by default.
consent.evidenceClipsHint: Cuts up to 6 short silent clips (about 8 s) around cited moments. Off by default.
consent.keepForRetry: Keep the video for 7 days if the analysis fails
consent.keepForRetryHint: Lets you retry without uploading again. Otherwise the video of a failed analysis is deleted after 24 hours.

reason.identity_confirmed: You confirmed which player you are.
reason.target_not_seen: You were not clearly seen in the reviewed frames.
reason.sampled_frames_only: Based on still frames, not continuous video.
reason.cv_worker_not_configured: Needs the tracking service, which is not enabled.
reason.cv_events_not_validated: Tracker events are not validated yet.
reason.use_gps: Use a GPS session for distance and speed.

video.possibleEventsHint: Suggested from still frames. They are not counted as statistics.

clip.title: Clip review
clip.notVisible: You were not clearly visible in this clip, so no coaching was given.

lifecycle.deleted: The original video was deleted. {{count}} cited frames are kept privately.
lifecycle.retained: The original video is kept in your media library. {{count}} cited frames are kept privately.
lifecycle.absent: No video was uploaded. {{count}} cited frames are kept privately.
lifecycle.pending: Temporary media will be removed automatically.

files.unsupported: Choose an MP4 or MOV video.
files.too_long: Videos can be up to {{minutes}} minutes long.
files.too_large: This file is too large to upload. Choose a shorter or lower-quality export.
files.no_duration: The video could not be read. Check that it plays in the Files app.
files.low_disk: Your phone is almost full. Free up some space and try again.

state.dismiss_false_event: You said this did not happen.
state.is_me: You confirmed this frame shows you.
state.not_me: You said this frame is not you.

correction.footnote: Your feedback is saved next to the analysis. The original analysis and any stats are not changed by it, and PitchProof does not use your footage or feedback to train AI.
correction.identityHint: If one of these frames is not you, say so. Coaching linked to that frame should then be treated with caution.

trends.title: Across your analyses
trends.locked: Trends appear after {{required}} completed analyses with confirmed identity of the same kind. You have {{completed}}.
trends.unknown: Not enough ratings to compare: {{metrics}}. A missing rating means unknown, not zero.
trends.caveat: A few analyses describe those videos only; they are not a statistically reliable trend. Different footage, camera angles and opponents change what can be seen.
